sentence_stem: If you have time on Saturday,
correct_completion: please come to my birthday party.
full_sentence: If you have time on Saturday, please come to my birthday party.
acceptable_variants: I would love to see you there.

options.why_wrong: This tells us about the speaker's feelings. It does not make an invitation that fits the condition about having time.
This gives a detail about the party, but it does not invite the listener to come.

options.text: please come to my birthday party.
my cat is black and white.
options.why_wrong: This is a fact about a cat. It has no connection to the condition or to an invitation.

grammar_focus: First conditional with 'if' and an invitation in the main clause
explanation: After 'if', the main clause should give a result that fits the condition. Here the result is an invitation to the party.
translation: Se você tiver tempo no sábado, por favor venha à minha festa de aniversário.
